findings.value: A registered charity running a theatre in Dalston, E8, which says it makes daring, high-quality work for East London and beyond. Time Out names its summer Grimeborn festival of new opera as its biggest constant.

evidence.quote: Arcola produces daring, high-quality theatre in the heart of East London and beyond.
Arcola Theatre Production Company is a registered charity no.1108613
Its biggest constant is Grimeborn, an irreverent and influential festival of new opera writing that takes place in the summer

notes: Time Out's venue page is undated, so it backs the summary only, not music. Recent Hackney Citizen tag page (2026 headlines on Arcola productions) shows the theatre running, but I could not open the article links through page_text in this run, so nothing from it is used. No closure or ownership news found.
